# ChoiceLib

`ChoiceLib` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `field:help()`.

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`help()`](help.md) | Set the field help text. | 1.5.10 |
| [`title()`](title.md) | Set the choice menu title. | 1.6.1 |
| [`values()`](values.md) | Set the choice values. | 1.6.2 |
